subject: Community Car
author: SUFFUR
body:
I did a post at the doghouse forums, and it's cool, the Elites do do (I know what i mean, but looking at it now I laugh, HE HE)a lot of work for the Criterion Forums and some do some very interesting stuff with in the game, and now a target car to takedown, lol.😈, has been given to them, as a gift for their hard work.

ZeroJay, should have a hat ontop of his new car, he never goes of line, maybe a Burger King Car with a Crown on it should be his, just a shame about his hard nose 'tu'd to people who are still unsure, where Paradise was going, and what it left behind, but he's a hard working guy putting up with a lot of crap so, what can be expected, yes it was a compliment, no forum march needed, of 'ZeroJay The Hero', 'Suffur Is The Anti-'I can't think, i'm rarley anti-anything, i'm for education, human rights, non abuse to children, not anti Paradise, I play it to much, but I did compalin about the lack of decent TD physics, and other bugs with Paradise, it's look, and the racing just is not the same as the other games, I've got one, sorry Fishermen everywhere, 'Suffur Is Anti-Fish' and if anyone has a Gamer tag called 'Fish', Sorry, just like Jeff's friend 'Peanut' would say, without the lisp, though maybe in Japanese Dubbing, and then tries to laugh like Peanut, and starts choking. And once again I digress, or Tangenate.

With the Cagent up-date, Criterion/Burnout Team, though I think Burnout Team is the right thing to say now because Criterion are a games company making something else by now (we hope, what on, who cares, they do make good games, even if not everyone loves them, but the attitude to games, is hype, so when their ready to tell, we'll be told), can do a lot within the game on the fly, adjust stuff, tweak a bit here, don't know what really, but that's how they put it across, so stuff is going to be happening all the time on Paradise.

It does have some racing, though for the most part it's just a chillout game to drive around in. And with calender events, people are now going to have something to do besides dicking about with your mates, sounds like a new take on gameplay, similar to what Bungie does, but with cars, so don't miss out, download Cagney today, what sorry, if you have a 360, you'll have to wait, but it'll be worth it, it's a new game with in a game, wow, Game Changing Content, who would have thought, in this day and age.

I wonder when the next chance for a custom skin for the car comp' comes up, we could create a Burnoutahoilcs.com skin, as well as the guys at Operationburnout, and the other fan sites. Would be cool.

I think, the thing that bothers me is that two cars, then bikes are not going to have boost, could change, see above, if you still don't get it, go up further about education, and Burnout is not there,  because you can't burn without boost? But since the game now has that experimental feel, why not. It's a driving game that changes as and when, they do go fast without boost to be competative, so it's still a fast game, you have to take that for granted, but its a who cares if you crash going balls out, you just start again from where you were and keep going until you crash again. I think Road rage, online and Marked Man, will get people learning the map better and the traffic patterns.

The Road Rules for street times now happen in the background, during freeburn, racing, stunt running and all the other modes, so tearing around and not crashing for me now means I earn something, without the pressure of forgeting to activate it, which happens a lot, sometimes after a crash or a challenge.

I'm happy about the update, and will be even happier when I get a go on it. But till then Revenge will tied me over, for my racing needs, Paradise for my messing about. Is that right, Tied or is it tyed, or tide or tyied, well what ever, till next time I want to dribble , cya later and have fun Burning.

Oh I just thought, the Olympus is a Hydrogen Car like Arnie's and the new Elite one is electirc Tesla one, so no fuel to burn, hence no boost "fire"? And why they don't need to go into the garages, as they get charged up in the Junk Yards, when you turn the game off.

I need sleep.

I miss numpty with Monkey in the room, no decent Red team, and no Monkey you are the pedistooled best in my eyes and a lot of others, live with, and use it to get free drinks😉.

Feel the pressure, and mold it into rank.

PS still want your thumbs if you die, then I will be the button masher king, also I know some kids are better than you but their thumbs are smaller, and I would look radiculas with 4 thumbs, 2 big and 2 small, they need to look similar, could you also tan them up a bit too.

Must stop dribbling, bye.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
